subject.title: Gateway leaks transient sessions when target session transcript is missing during polling

question: Should maintainers require current-main live or regression proof for the `/tools/invoke` `sessions_list` missing-transcript polling loop before this issue is closed or promoted to a replacement fix?
rationale: Source inspection shows read-only safeguards that may have fixed the failure, but the previous candidate PR is closed unmerged and no direct current-main proof demonstrates the reported store-growth symptom is gone.

options.title: Require current-main polling proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a focused repro or test shows whether repeated missing-transcript polling still grows the session store on current main.

options.title: Promote a replacement fix
options.body: If a maintainer can reproduce the leak, ask for a narrow Gateway session-list fix with regression coverage rather than reviving the closed broadcast-side PR.

options.title: Close from source review only
options.body: Close only if a maintainer accepts the current read-only source paths as sufficient proof without live reproduction, noting that no merged fixing PR exists.

recommendation.title: Require current-main polling proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a focused repro or test shows whether repeated missing-transcript polling still grows the session store on current main.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent transcript reader and session accessor seam work is closest to the current read-only behavior that may determine proof sufficiency.
